title: Compose hosted publication predictions over the guarded queue worker
description: Implement the central application slice authorized by Ryan on2026-10-20 for Papyrus Monitoring: one shared remote multi-output engine, existing Prospectus account/role authorization, existing queue/worker and native S3 SDK storage. Bind account/publication/output/run revisions explicitly; use the same source revision for all publication projections. Papyrus consumer PR382 is green at603767e2. Reuse existing components and keep secrets out of config/records. No deployment, new infrastructure, credential creation or permission grants. Live models remain off by default; no labels, seeding or training. Normal sign-in with the explicitly selected ryan@anth.us reached a failed callback, so current account/role remains unverified. Keep that blocker visible; do not infer membership or weaken verification.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Login root-cause evidence: bounded BFF structured logs show fresh challenge HTTP200 then central /v1/identities/google/resolve HTTP401 about34 seconds later, proving state/token exchange/local pair verification completed. Selected deployed central handler source issues signed challengeToken without persisting challengeId; the deployed/current Cyclotron client drops challengeToken and sends only that unpersisted ID. Central signer-setting presence verified as boolean only; no secret/SSM reads. Added red-then-green compatibility specs and minimal source fix preserving opaque signed evidence in existing encrypted one-use pending state, forwarding signed token alone to central verification, keeping legacy stored IDs and rejecting malformed signed evidence. 77 sign-in/session tests passed. Previous draft head7cbd587 is fully green in CI. Fix remains undeployed; account verification remains blocked. Deployed artifact has other owner session/telemetry changes absent from main, so its owner must reconcile release source before deployment; do not overwrite or weaken existing security behavior.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Standing publication runs, machine access and provider key wiring shipped (2026-10-21).

Source: PR 69 merged to develop, PR 70 promoted to main, release v0.30.0 (main 002e6f2). CI green on both PRs.

Deployed to the Cyclotron console stack (change set reviewed before execution; it contained only the two function code references, the new IAM-authorized machine route and its Lambda permission, the Secrets Manager read statement on the worker role, and two optional empty-by-default environment parameters). Both functions run the same artifact, which preserves every existing dependency and UI member and adds the pure-Python Jev SDK dependencies the deployed artifact lacked. Live prediction is still off. No target, run, principal or secret has been configured yet. Signed-out sign-in initiation and session health verified after the update; an unsigned machine request is rejected with 403 at the gateway.

What exists: a standing target flag (operator configuration only) that registers streaming sources inside the fenced worker transaction, a trusted cumulative request ceiling with optional accruing daily allowance, SigV4 machine routes for decide, status and feedback bound to an exact allow-listed role, and a lazily read provider secret that fails closed before any state or request. Details in docs/hosted-publications.md.

Still gated: creating the standing run, configuring the target and machine caller role, creating the provider secret, and enabling live prediction. No labels, training or provider calls were made.
